g.text: Master on the arm wrist, tool parked in its dock. Coupling ring drawn see-through; 3 pins in 3 steel V-seats (kinematic coupling), preloaded by 3 spring plungers.
Arm brings the master to the parked tool with the wrist rolled 45 deg, so the 3 windows line
The skirt guides the spigot into the bore. The pins pass up through the windows; the blade
Wrist roll turns the master 45 deg. Each pin rides a ramp (plungers push back), crosses the
crest and drops between 2 steel dowels.
At the dock the master rolls back 45 deg, the pins line up with the windows again and the
arm backs away. The magnet holds the tool.

Ring and skirt drawn see-through. Dowel 3 x 12, ball 5/32 in, spring 5 x 0.7 x 10, N52 magnet 6 x 3 as in the exploded diagram. Concept render from the current CAD. Lock torque and clearances: docs/DESIGN_v4.md.
